newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian inflation quickens to 18.8 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian inflation quickens to 18.8 pct in Sept.

text.p: inflation quickened to 18.8 percent in September from 17.1
percent in August, National Statistics Institute figures show.
BULGARIAN CONSUMER PRICES SEPT AUG SEPT'95
Food prices rose 21.9 percent in September, non-foods rose 16.8 percent and services 12.6 percent, figures showed.
Gasoline rose by 13.2 percent in September, diesel fuel gained 22 percent and electricity increased 14 percent last month.
Prices of foods increased by 156.5 percent from January through September while energy prices for households surged 275.3 percent.
Transportation and communication services' prices rose 192.1 percent in the first nine months while prices of health services increased by 118 percent. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
